messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — planning a Console UI deploy today at 14:00 PT (now + ~20m). Changes: header animation, minor CSS refactor, and a tweak to the onboarding copy. No backend schema changes. Who can cover canary + edge cache flush?

sasha: I can take cache/edge stuff. Plan: wait for canary healthy, then do origin purge + edge flush at +3m post-canary. Need the asset-manifest (hash -> filename) and the public path we'll be serving from.

mike: I will run the canary. Target start 14:05 PT, 10m smoke window. Steps I'll do: 1) deploy to canary pool, 2) sanity health checks, 3) validate metrics (p95 latency, 5xxs), 4) promote. If any failure, revert to tag release/console-stable. I'll post rollback command here.

jamie: Asset manifest: attached snippet below — hashed files are under /static/v2/. Use the map: 
```
{
  "main.css": "main.8f3c2.css",
  "bundle.js": "bundle.4a7b9.js"
}
```
Public path: https://assets.console.redwood/ (CDN will be pointed to that origin).

sasha: perfect. I will schedule purge at 14:08 PT (+3m after your canary start). Will run `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id XXX --paths "/static/v2/*"` and verify edge propagation. Expect ~2-5m for global TTL drop.

laura: QA checklist for the smoke window (small set): top nav loads, sign-in flow, onboarding modal appears, feature flag A is off, welcome banner copy updated. If anything looks off, react with :warning: and call rollback.

mike: Smoke checklist notes — I'll run quick curl probes first: 
```bash
curl -sS https://canary.console.redwood/health | jq .
curl -sS https://canary.console.redwood/ | grep "Welcome to Console"
```
Will also open Sentry and LiveView dashboards, watching for new errors.

jamie: Deploy-bot, please post the canary URL when it's up and the build hash.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: https://canary.console.redwood/ (build: d9a21b6). Health: OK.

mike: Canary up. Running smoke checks now. Watching p95 and 5xx on frontend-internal. Will call promote at 14:15 if green.

sasha: Starting origin purge now (14:08 PT). Invalidation request ID: I-0a1b2c3d. Edge flush in progress. ETA 3m for global propagation.

laura: QA on standby — running manual flows now. Report back in thread.

jamie: Reminder: rollback command if promote fails: `kubectl set image deploy/console-frontend console=registry.redwood/console:release-stable --namespace=console` and `deploy-bot rollback release-stable` (locks for hotfix).

mike: Smoke window clear — no regressions in 10m, p95 within target, errors unchanged. Proceeding to promote to prod at 14:16 PT.

sasha: Edge flush shows propagated; cache hit-rates falling as expected.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Prod URL: https://console.redwood/ (build: d9a21b6). Release notes: small visual tweaks + onboarding copy.

laura: QA quick pass: top nav good, onboarding copy matches spec, no major layout regressions. Looks good from product side. :tada:

jamie: Thanks all — leaving this thread open 15m for any late regression reports. If anyone spots issues, tag @mike and @sasha immediately.
